claim_boundary.allowed: Gate2C7 may establish that exact projection-qualified C1 origin authority repairs the preregistered seven Python C1 development cases under the frozen authority and adversarial qualification contract.
forbidden: generalizing repair soundness beyond the admitted Python fragment

decision_rule.candidate_c1_rerun_authorized_only_if: Synthetic producer and independent checker both PASS all frozen cases, dual replays are logically byte-identical, and no forbidden surface was read or modified.
decision_rule.on_any_real_c1_failure: Do not broaden support or open heldout evidence; freeze/diagnose the proximal blocker without post-hoc rule changes.
decision_rule.on_any_synthetic_failure: Do not run candidate C1; preserve failure provenance and diagnose.
decision_rule.on_repaired_lane_success: Freeze repaired lane before Candidate58 additive requalification.
decision_rule.repaired_lane_success: All seven selected Python cases attain VALID_C1 under the repaired independent C1 path, with raw-origin evidence retained and projection certificates admitted exactly as preregistered.

execution_sequence: freeze this prospective protocol as a protocol-only commit
create C1-only minimal implementation and checker/harness tied to this protocol commit
run frozen adversarial synthetic qualification without candidate C1 execution
run exactly seven Python C1 development cases and no other Candidate58 population
if and only if repaired lane meets decision rule, immutably freeze repaired C1 lane
perform Candidate58 additive requalification under a separately recorded execution receipt

independence_contract.certificate_derivation: C1 derives root, operand, kinds, and opaque tokens directly from the raw AST plus frozen execution-signature/source-contract authority; it may compare to but may not copy candidate projection tokens from Gate2C5/Gate2C6.
independence_contract.independent_checker: Checker must implement certificate reconstruction independently and must not import the production resolution helper.
independence_contract.production_surface: Only C1 raw-source world-role resolution may change; primary adapter/world derivation and semantic kernel are forbidden surfaces.

purpose: Permit a refined raw C1 origin to supply a declared base world-role value only when an independently derived opaque projection certificate exactly matches frozen canonical authority; preserve raw origin evidence and fail closed otherwise.

repair_contract.base_origin_passthrough: If the raw origin exactly equals a declared world role, preserve existing C1 lookup behavior and require no projection certificate.
repair_contract.fingerprint_schema: SHA-256 canonical JSON of {root_role,terminal_guard_operand_index,steps:[{kind,token_digest_sha256}]}, identical in schema to Gate2C5 but independently derived from raw C1 AST state.

projection_kinds.ATTRIBUTE: token digest = SHA-256 exact UTF-8 attribute token
projection_kinds.SUBSCRIPT_LITERAL: token digest = SHA-256 canonical JSON bytes of literal key

repair_contract.refined_origin_admission: A refined origin may resolve to a base world role only through one unique, independently derived projection certificate that exactly matches frozen canonical authority.

semantic_role_resolution.ambiguity: zero or more than one authority match fails closed
semantic_role_resolution.required: exact certificate equality to the unique frozen authority row for the base role

repair_contract.world_lookup: World role_values lookup may use resolved_semantic_role only after certificate admission; raw observed origin remains unchanged in binding/lineage/provenance evidence.
